info.title: Hyperbolic API
info.description: HTTP API for Hyperbolic's on-demand GPU compute: rent virtual machines and bare-metal instances, manage storage volumes, and track usage and billing. Authenticate with a Bearer API key (`Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`).

servers.description: Legacy host — the same API on Hyperbolic's original domain, kept for existing integrations.

tags.name: virtual-machine-rentals
tags.description: **Deprecated.** Manage virtual machine rentals. These endpoints are still supported for now but are no longer preferred.

tags.name: bare-metal-rentals
tags.description: **Deprecated.** Manage bare metal rentals. These endpoints are still supported for now but are no longer preferred.

get.summary: Get the public API specification
get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 document for the public API exactly as this environment serves it, including only the endpoints this environment has enabled. This endpoint is open: it takes no API key, and sending one changes nothing about the response.

schema.title: OpenAPI document
schema.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document describing the public API as the environment serving it actually runs. The example is abridged — the real response lists every public operation and the schemas they reference.

post.description: Rent a virtual machine or a bare metal server. `rentalType` decides which machine-type-specific fields apply; sending a field for the other type is a BAD_REQUEST (INVALID_INPUT_FOR_RENTAL_TYPE).

rentalType.description: The machine type to rent. Fields marked for one machine type are rejected for the other.

gpuCount.description: GPUs to rent. Bare metal rents whole nodes, so a multiple of 8.

networkType.description: Required for bare metal. Virtual machines default to `ethernet`.

region.description: A region that offers the chosen machine type.

sshPublicKeyId.description: The saved SSH key to authorize on the rental. Defaults to the most recently added key.

post.summary: Reboot a single instance within a rental
post.description: Reboots one instance in place; tenant data is preserved. Call it only for an instance whose `instances[].supportedFeatures` includes `guest-reboot`. Reports INVALID_INSTANCE_REF for an `instanceRef` outside this rental, REBOOT_NOT_SUPPORTED for a rental whose provider cannot reboot, and REBOOT_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS while one is in flight.
